pages.text: The $(item)Otherworld Goggles$() are what advanced summoners use to see the $(#ad03fc)Otherworld$(), to avoid the negative side effects of $(l:getting_started/demons_dream)demons_dream$(/l).$(br2)Making your first pair of these is seen by many as a rite of passage.$(br)

pages.title: Crafting Goggles
pages.text: Crafting these goggles is a multi-step process described in detail in the Entry about $(l:crafting_rituals/craft_otherworld_goggles)Crafting Otherworld Goggles$(/l).$(br)
